caption.en: Three UAVs run the Track and share baseline under Realistic physics with L2 observations, and all four scored events of the handoff event are captured.
caption.zh: 在 Realistic 物理档与 L2 观测下，三架无人机运行 Track and share 基线，交接事件的四个计分事件全部被采集。

caption.en: Three UAVs fly the Coverage scan baseline lanes under Realistic physics with L2 observations, and three of the four scored events of the handoff event are captured.
caption.zh: 在 Realistic 物理档与 L2 观测下，三架无人机按 Coverage scan 基线沿条带航线飞行，交接事件的四个计分事件中采集到三个。

caption.en: Three UAVs hold fixed observation points with a sweeping camera (Static guard baseline) under Realistic physics with L2 observations, and all four scored events of the handoff event are captured.
caption.zh: 在 Realistic 物理档与 L2 观测下，三架无人机以 Static guard 基线驻守固定观察位并扫视，交接事件的四个计分事件全部被采集。

caption.en: Two pedestrians hand over a package at the plaza while three UAVs run the Track and share baseline under Realistic physics with L2 observations; the meeting, the handoff and the building entry are all captured.
caption.zh: 两名行人在广场交接包裹，三架无人机在 Realistic 物理档与 L2 观测下运行 Track and share 基线，会遇、交接与进楼三个计分事件全部被采集。

caption.en: The target enters two buildings among look-alike distractors while three UAVs run the Track and share baseline under Realistic physics with L2 observations; both scored building entries are captured.
caption.zh: 目标先后进入两栋建筑并有外观相近的干扰者在场，三架无人机在 Realistic 物理档与 L2 观测下运行 Track and share 基线，两个计分的进楼事件均被采集。

caption.en: Three UAVs fly lanes ordered by the search prior (Coverage scan baseline) under Realistic physics with L2 observations, and all three scored target windows are captured.
caption.zh: 在 Realistic 物理档与 L2 观测下，三架无人机按搜索先验排序的航带飞行（Coverage scan 基线），三个计分的目标窗口全部被采集。

caption.en: A target vehicle drives among distractor vehicles while three UAVs run the Track and share baseline under Realistic physics with L2 observations; the scored junction pass is captured.
caption.zh: 目标车辆与干扰车辆同场行驶，三架无人机在 Realistic 物理档与 L2 观测下运行 Track and share 基线，计分的路口通过事件被采集。
